Name: Scarlett's Seasonal Anime Potraits
Author: DonutSteelPeas
Description:
Got more interested in Scarlett after seeing BunBunz's amazing anime interpretation and decided I wanted her to be functional with Seasonal Outfits and was tired of waiting for somebody to do it and did it myself! I'm by no means an artist so hopefully you can overlook my work if it's shoddy, just wanted to make something satisfactory to me and hope you'll enjoy it as well!

(Plus, the design reminded me of someone special :))

Deserved Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/185039619]bunzbunzMODS[/url] for the Base Portrait used, please check out their mod at:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17516](SVE) Anime Portraits Replacer at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]
P.S. If you're not okay with this release please dm me and I'll take it down ASAP!

How to Install:
First install: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]
Next: Simply just replace the folder containing Scarlett's Portrait's with my own! (If on vortex you must empty Scarlett's folder on Seasonal Outfits - Slight Cuter Aesthetic for SVE out, DEPLOY, then put portraits in, REDEPLOY)

Downloads.Description: Take these files and move them into Seasonal Outfits for SVE's assets -> Potraits -> Scarlett, replacing the portraits originally from there.
